description: ERECTION OF A SIDE AND REAR SINGLE STOREY EXTENSION AND ERECTION OF A L-SHAPED REAR DORMER.
decision_conditions:
﻿Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the windows on the side elevation of the L-shaped dormer elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass and fixed shut below 1.7m and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
